newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Suez Canal Bank to double capital to 100 mln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Suez Canal Bank to double capital to 100 mln pounds.

text.p: Egypt's Suez Canal Bank said on Tuesday it would double its paid-up capital to 100 million pounds ($29.5 million) by issuing bonus shares and offering shareholders new equity.
The bank said in a published announcement it would issue two million bonus shares equivalent to 40 percent of the 50 million capital.
It would offer existing shareholders three million new shares of ten-pound face value, the announcement said. The new share is priced at 50 pounds.
The share closed on the stock exchange on Monday at 148.32 pounds. The share offer will remain open for one month from September 7, the bank said.
The bank also recently approved raising authorised capital from 100 to 500 million pounds.
